subject.title: Adopt the core durable ingress drain on the remaining channels (WhatsApp, Discord, Slack, Signal, iMessage)

question: Should this issue close as the completed five-channel rollout named in its title, with later fleet waves and WhatsApp live proof tracked separately, or remain the active umbrella for the expanded fleet-wide adoption plan?
rationale: The merged work appears to complete the original named channels, but subsequent maintainer discussion intentionally broadened the issue and retained verification work; automation cannot safely choose its durable tracking scope.

options.title: Split and close the named rollout
options.body: Close this issue after recording the five completed channel migrations, and create or link a narrower canonical tracker for wave 3, wave 4, and any outstanding live verification.

options.title: Keep the fleet umbrella
options.body: Retitle or clarify this issue as the fleet-wide durable-ingress rollout and retain it until the later channel waves and verification round complete.

recommendation.title: Split and close the named rollout
recommendation.body: Close this issue after recording the five completed channel migrations, and create or link a narrower canonical tracker for wave 3, wave 4, and any outstanding live verification.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned contributor authored the rollout plan, the current scope update, and the relevant merged adapter work.
